title: Finite reduction of the normalized integral-stage projection
statement: Let D,C,E,n,hn,S be the six-functor operation datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. For a separated finite-type f:X→Y, a compactification c, an arbitrary bounded constructible integral K on X, and a bounded constructible integral L on Y satisfying S.integralFiniteTorDomain, reduction at every positive exponent m+1 of the specified compact-support projection [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] is isomorphic, as an arrow in the ambient finite derived category, to CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component for S.integralNormalization.finiteLevels m, reduced K, and any finite-Tor representative L_m whose underlying object equals the reduction of L. No invertibility of either projection is asserted. Only the second integral input is restricted to uniform finite Tor amplitude.

theorem integralStageProjection_reduction
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (_hL : S.integralFiniteTorDomain Y L) (m : ℕ)
    (Lₘ : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E (m + 1)
      (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m)) Y.obj.left)
    (hLₘ : Lₘ.obj = ((sixFunctorIntegralReduction D C E m Y).obj L).obj) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk
      ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension C.l E Y.obj.left m).map
        (compactSupportProjectionComponent S.higher.integralExchange f c K L).hom) ≅
      Arrow.mk (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component
        (S.integralNormalization.finiteLevels m) f c
        ((sixFunctorIntegralReduction D C E m X).obj K) Lₘ).hom)
